name: Uzzah
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy

points: When they came to Nachon's threshingfloor, the oxen shook the cart, and Uzzah put forth his hand and took hold of the ark. The anger of the Lord was kindled, and God smote him for his error, and he died there by the ark.

note.label: 2 Samuel 6: David Brings Up the Ark of God

points: David was displeased that the Lord had made a breach upon Uzzah, and he was afraid of the Lord that day, saying, How shall the ark of the Lord come to me? David had seen the power of the Lord, and his flesh trembled for fear of Him and His judgments.

note.label: 2 Samuel 6: David Brings Up the Ark of God

points: When they came to the threshingfloor of Chidon, the oxen stumbled and Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark.
The oxen stumbled, Uzza put his hand up to steady the ark, and the Lord smote him and he died right there.

note.label: When Good Intentions Lead To Bad Judgement In Israel

points: The anger of the Most High was kindled against Uzza, and He smote him because he put his hand to the ark, and he died there before the Most High. The ark was only to be touched by the Levites; the Most High does not play.
David was displeased that the Most High had made a breach upon Uzza, and that place was called Perez-uzza. David was afraid that day and asked how he could bring the ark home.
